sourceState: Uncommitted CSS diff against sourceSHA; verdict binds to sourceCssSHA256.
scope: companionChat.css: root, input/textarea/select, and message font sizes set to user-requested 14px. Related E2E expectations and 390px case inspected. No source or test edits by reviewer.

criteria.success: Scoped 14px Inter body and inputs, normal tracking, retained brand hierarchy and no viewport clipping.
criteria.failure: CSS leakage into parent/other surfaces, wrong computed sizes, loss of legibility, overflow or clipped controls.
criteria.verification: Diff and selector-use audit, independent original-resolution pixel inspection at 375x667, 390x844 and 1280x900; final typography/geometry evidence.

observations: Only three font-size rules change. Companion classes occur only in the chat implementation; root inheritance flows to descendants, not its parent. No changed global type rule.
Final typography evidence at all three viewports shows user/assistant/composer Inter 14px, weight 400; header text controls stay 14px/600 and true timestamp metadata stays JetBrains Mono 11px/400.
CUA 390px metrics show selects 14px/400 and visible text buttons 14px/600; sampled mobile controls retain heights of at least 44px.

Active intake pixels show clean wrapping, distinct gold user bubbles, readable assistant text and fully drawn composer icons. Brief editing and review fields fit at mobile width; headings retain hierarchy.
Geometry evidence reports horizontal overflow 0 at 375, 390 and 1280px, centered mascot offset 0, and retained 88px mobile/96px desktop mascot dimensions.

Colors, materials, radii, motion, avatar, prompt content and parent surface are unchanged by the scoped CSS diff. The requested 14px body/input choice overrides the default DESIGN.md 16px body token and remains above the 12px legibility floor.

evidence.smokeReportedBySeparateAgent: 39/39 final cases PASS, exit 0; original 16px baseline failed all four focused 14px assertions.

limits: Reviewer inspected source, evidence metrics and pixels; test execution was performed by the separate smoke agent and parent.
Screenshots use the local mocked fixture. Real providers, generated video playback and production data were not exercised.
Physical iOS keyboard, browser focus zoom and phone performance remain unverified.
